name: Night nanny care
summary: How new parents in Singapore hire night nannies for newborn sleep stretches — scope vs confinement nannies, safety expectations, and short-contract norms.
body:
Night nannies focus on overnight feeds, settling, and letting parents sleep in blocks. They differ from full confinement nannies who cover days and cooking. Agencies and independents both operate; verify identity and references.

## Scope to define
- Overnight hours and wake windows
- Feeding plan (breast milk bottles, formula rules)
- Sleep training philosophy alignment — or explicit “no training” briefs
- Backup cover when the nanny is ill
- Transport home after dawn shifts

Clarify whether light laundry of bottles is included.

## How to choose
Interview on safe sleep practices and emergency contacts. Prefer written short contracts with notice clauses. Be cautious of cash-only arrangements without emergency contacts. Pair with paediatric guidance rather than outsourcing medical judgement to overnight carers.

## Practical tip
Do a paid trial night before a multi-week booking. Leave a one-page care sheet on the counter — hungry babies are not the time to hunt WhatsApp threads.
